prompt: A walled market town with a gatehouse on each road.

card.name: Marketwall

site.text: A walled town on level ground, enclosed by a defensive wall with a gatehouse where each road enters

style.text: Plain medieval market town: timber and stone, wall of stone brick, banners and lanterns

purpose.text: A market town where traders and townsfolk buy and sell goods

card.interpretation: A flat-land walled market town in a plain medieval look, enclosed by a wall with a gatehouse at each road. I assumed four roads, so four gatehouses, with a market hall and square at the centre and homes, an inn, a smithy and a chapel inside the wall.
assumptions: Four roads enter the town, so four gatehouses
Medieval style, as none was given
Wall form follows the ring_wall template

program.notes: One at each road entrance through the wall; arched passage, portcullis, guard room above.
Covered trading hall facing the market square, the heart of the town.
Lodging for travelling traders, near the main road.
Homes of merchants and townsfolk with shopfronts below.
Tools and horseshoes for market goers.
Small town chapel off the square.
